title: Leafy Pumpkins Clipart - Ink Black
author: Amanda Ilkov
description:
*** Leafy Pumpkins Clipart & Vector Graphics Download Description ***
This professional quality, Ink Black colored pumpkin clipart set includes 14 different pumpkin images with leaves and curly vines. 
These large, clear images are perfect for Fall, Thanksgiving or Halloween design projects. 
This set of colorful pumpkins was digitally illustrated by me, Mandy!
*** File Formats ***
These pumpkins are provided as both PNG (with transparent backgrounds) and EPS Vector formats, making them pretty much universal. You can use them in anything from Procreate to Photoshop to Cricut Design Space.
*** Colors Available ***
When you download the Leafy Pumpkin Clipart PNG & Vectors set, you can choose from 122 different colors. So although you are welcome to recolour the images on your own, if you don’t have access to software that lets you change image colors, no worries! Just search my shop for “Leafy Pumpkins Clipart” to bring up all of your color options. 
*** Included in the Download ***
Includes 14 PNG Images saved in 2 formats.
– 14 PNG images (saved at approximately 1800px by 1800px with transparent backgrounds)
– 14 EPS vectors (can be recoloured and resized indefinitely using any vector software like Adobe Illustrator or Inkscape)
*** How To Use Leafy Pumpkin Clipart PNG & Vectors ***
One of my favorite things about clipart is its versatility. You can use it in an endless number of creative projects. Here are some ideas to get you started:
– Pumpkin Stickers
– Fall Journal Pages
– Fall Scrapbooking
– Thanksgiving Decorations
– Classroom Materials
